name: Strands of Fate
text: At the start of the battle, roll 12 dice; you may re-roll the whole set again and again, each time with one die fewer, then keep the result as your Fate dice. Just before a roll for a unit with this ability (Advance, Battle-shock, Charge, Damage, Hit, Save or Wound), spend a Fate die in place of one die of that roll; it counts as unmodified.

name: Fortune
text: Psychic. In your Command phase, roll one D6: on a 2 or more, pick a friendly AELDARI unit with a model within 12 inches of this model. Until the start of your next Command phase, each attack that targets that unit suffers -1 to its wound roll.

name: Defenders of Fate
text: At the end of your Command phase, for each objective marker you control that has a model of this unit within range, roll one D6 and add a Fate die showing the value rolled.

name: Crewed Platform
text: When the last Guardian Defender model in this unit is destroyed, every Heavy Weapon Platform model remaining in the unit is destroyed too.

name: Swift Demise
text: Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack that targets the closest eligible target, you may re-roll a Hit roll of 1; if that target is within range of an objective marker your opponent controls, you may re-roll the Hit roll instead.

name: Patrol Squads
text: When you declare battle formations, before any unit is set up, this unit may split into two units of 3 models, each containing one scatter laser Windrider. Each half keeps all of its abilities.
